THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper B · Domain 13 Research Methods, Statistics, Critical Review and Evidence-Based Practice

Aim and objectives

Aim. To prepare you to appraise systematic reviews and meta-analyses and turn pooled results into NNTs and survival estimates for MRCPsych Paper B.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Distinguish a systematic review from a meta-analysis and describe a reproducible search across databases such as MEDLINE, Embase and PsycINFO.
  2. Interpret heterogeneity using Cochran's Q and I squared, and explain when pooling studies is inappropriate.
  3. Recognise publication bias on a funnel plot and explain why precision from pooling is not the same as truth.
  4. Compare fixed-effect and random-effects models and interpret a forest plot, including the squares, lines and pooled diamond.
  5. Calculate the NNT as 1/ARR from a baseline risk, and interpret survival and cumulative incidence curves.
  6. Answer the chapter's 38 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
